description: This file is the source code for the 'marked' library, a JavaScript Markdown parser and compiler. It includes classes and functions for lexing, parsing, rendering, and options configuration, with support for GFM and tables.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering HTML output for various Markdown elements.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing tokens into HTML.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Class responsible for lexing Markdown source into tokens.

classes.name: InlineLexer
classes.description: Class responsible for inline lexing and output of inline Markdown elements.

methods.name: marked
methods.description: Main function to parse Markdown source into HTML, with optional callback for async operation.

methods.name: Renderer.prototype.code
methods.description: Render code block with optional language class.

methods.name: Renderer.prototype.table
methods.description: Render table with header and body.

methods.name: Renderer.prototype.tablecell
methods.description: Render table cell with optional header and alignment.
